mapper.select: select t.user_id id, t.parent_id pid, u.user_name as label, u.user_rank userRank from hub_user_diagram t left join hub_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by t.parent_id, t.user_id

with recursive tree (user_id, parent_id) as (select t1.user_id, t1.parent_id from hub_user_diagram t1 where user_id = #{userId} union select t2.user_id, t2.parent_id from hub_user_diagram t2 join tree on t2.parent_id = tree.user_id) select distinct tree.user_id from tree JOIN hub_user u on tree.user_id = u.user_id
